title: VIXEN CMake requires manual UNDERTOW_ROOT pairing for every queued build
body: The documented Release configure failed before compilation because VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt requires UNDERTOW_ROOT. Recovery required fetching origin/main-wave and manually supplying UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/pair-hlsl to both configure/build and codegen checks. Suggested consolidation: make the pinned Undertow provider pairing part of the VIXEN configure/codegen facade so a queued consumer build derives or validates it without lane-specific environment setup. Tier luna: this affects cross-repo provisioning and requires a reusable pairing contract.
